Account.profileIntro: Stored on Heirloom's server only, never on the blockchain. Used for invitations and alerts.
Account.name: Name
Account.keyBody: This key lets guardians and your beneficiaries encrypt things to you. Its public half is registered on-chain; the private half is stored with your account only in encrypted form.
Account.recoveryNote: A recovery file opens with the password it was created with. If you ever lose your password, <link>here is exactly what you can and cannot do</link>.
Account.passwordBody: Re-seals the same key under a new password. Your files, shares and guardians are unaffected. A fresh recovery file downloads automatically; older recovery files still need the old password.
Account.changed: Password changed. Keep the new recovery file somewhere safe.

Alerts.title: Alerts
Alerts.intro: If someone raises a claim on your vault, we email you a one-time link to cancel it with a single check-in. If you still have not checked in after 72 hours, we also send a text message. Guardians are warned 24 hours before a challenge period ends.
Alerts.emailOption: Email alerts. Sent to the address in your details, even if it is not verified yet.
Alerts.smsOption: Text-message alerts. Only sent to a verified phone number.
Alerts.smsUnavailable: Text messages are not set up on this server.
Alerts.smsNeedsVerify: Verify your phone below to turn this on.
Alerts.bothOff: Both channels are off: you will only see claims inside the app.
Alerts.changeNote: Change your email or phone in “Your details” above; a changed contact has to be verified again.
Alerts.recentNote: The log records what was sent and when, never your address or number or the message text.
